title: Holiday bingo fundraiser Sunday aims to push United Way toward its $1 million goal
excerpt: United Way of Laredo will hold a holiday bingo fundraiser on Sunday, Nov. 15, from 2 to 6 p.m. at The Barn at Los Patios, with presale tickets at $30 and tickets at the door for $35.
content:
United Way of Laredo will hold a holiday bingo fundraiser on Sunday, Nov. 15, from 2 to 6 p.m. at The Barn at Los Patios, as the organization works toward a $1 million fundraising goal, according to KGNS.

Presale tickets are $30, and tickets at the door are $35. The ticket bundle covers eight games, with special bingo cards played between games. The afternoon will also include door prizes, additional giveaways, food and activities for the whole family.

Daniel De La Miyar, president-elect of United Way, said fundraising for the community is the point — and reaching the $1 million goal takes creativity. “That's the most important thing, that we fundraise for the community. We are trying to reach that $1 million dollar goal, and we have to get creative and we have to do a lot of things,” De La Miyar told KGNS. He noted the organization recently held an adult spelling bee as another creative fundraiser.

For more information or to purchase tickets, call 956-723-9113. KGNS did not list an online ticket link.

Sources: KGNS, Nov. 10, 2026.
